l1_rationale: Randomized Phase III biomarker-selected PTEN-deficient prostate cancer trial demonstrated rPFS improvement of 7.5 months (HR 0.81; 95% CI 0.66-0.98; p=0.034). ODAC favored benefit-risk 7-1 with 1 abstention. Outcome already known: not a blind prediction.
major_risks: Immature overall survival; grade >=3 adverse events 67% vs 40.4%; hyperglycemia and rash; independent application-specific June 30 goal source missing
remaining_blocker: Obtain independently verified original or amended PDUFA goal for NDA 218197 S-004 before promoting 2026-L1-021
